task: Write fizzbuzz.py with a function fizzbuzz(n) returning 'Fizz', 'Buzz', 'FizzBuzz' or str(n).

criteria.text: fizzbuzz behaves correctly
criteria.command: python3 -c "from fizzbuzz import fizzbuzz as f; assert f(15)=='FizzBuzz' and f(3)=='Fizz' and f(5)=='Buzz' and f(7)=='7'"

task: Write slugify.py with slugify(s): lowercase, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single '-', strip leading/trailing '-'.

criteria.text: basic cases
criteria.command: python3 -c "from slugify import slugify as s; assert s('Hello, World!')=='hello-world'; assert s('  A  b ')=='a-b'; assert s('---')==''"

task: Write lru.py with class LRUCache(capacity) having get(key) (returns -1 if missing) and put(key, value), evicting the least recently used entry.

criteria.text: eviction order correct
criteria.command: python3 -c "from lru import LRUCache as L; c=L(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); c.get(1); c.put(3,3); assert c.get(2)==-1 and c.get(1)==1 and c.get(3)==3"
